thread:
katie_customer_success: Hey team, Acme reported missing rows in Manager > Team activity dashboard after we applied the new retention policy yesterday. They say the manager view shows nothing from Jan–Mar but individual user timelines still have events. Case #CS-3321. 

sam_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the tenant/org id and a quick screenshot? do they have linked sub-orgs? :thinking_face:

katie_customer_success: org_id=acme-42, linked_suborgs=true. Screenshot: https://files.redwood.example/CS-3321/manager-empty.png. They changed org retention from 365 -> 90 on 2025-11-10 per audit log.

sam_support: ok, initial checklist: confirmed dashboard query returned 0 rows for role_scope=manager and date>=2025-01-01. Individual user timelines (role_scope=user) return rows. pinging eng.

metrics-bot: alert: retention-change detected for org acme-42 by katie_customer_success @ 2025-11-10T17:03Z

dmitri_eng: looking. can you repro with the same query you're using in the console? paste the raw metrics API call if possible.

katie_customer_success: console uses the UI filter -> backend call: GET /api/v1/metrics/aggregate?org=acme-42&role_scope=manager&start=2025-01-01&end=2025-03-31&resolution=day (we saw 0 rows). changing role_scope=user returns expected counts.

dmitri_eng: thanks. quick debug: ran the same call against staging ingest of metrics and got results. running `select count(*) from aggregates where org_id='acme-42' and role_scope='manager' and ts >= '2025-01-01'` against ES index returns 0 in prod but non-zero in staging.

rachel_product: is this a permissions issue (role-based filter in the query) or actual pruning from retention? impact on reporting?

dmitri_eng: initial hunch: retention job for org-level policy incorrectly applied to aggregated-manager index for linked suborgs, causing "shadow deletion" of manager-aggregates while user-level events remained. audit logs show retention job ran and matched index pattern `aggregates-*` with an org_id rewrite for linked orgs. that rewrite is the smoking gun.

alex_sre: can we restore? do we have cold backups or a delayed ingestion stream we can re-run?

dmitri_eng: we have hot shards up to 90 days and snapshots older than that only if taken. since retention was shortened from 365 to 90, anything older than 90 days was eligible for deletion and was GC'd on 2025-11-10. Manager aggregates were pruned because the retention matcher used a parent-org TTL which overwrote linked orgs' retention config. so this is a data loss scenario for those aggregated rows.

sam_support: :grimacing: customer asked for ETA and possible temporary fix to show manager numbers. any workaround?

dmitri_eng: workaround: regenerate manager aggregates from user-level events if raw events still exist. however raw events are also subject to retention — in Acme's case user-level events for that period were preserved (weird but true) because they were stored in `events-*` partition which had a separate retention config. so we can run a backfill: run aggregation job over events -> populate aggregates index for manager scope for 2025-01..2025-03. estimate ~3 hours for their dataset. requires a one-off high-priority job and access to events index snapshot.

rachel_product: prioritize? customer is paying Dedicated contract. we need an SLA response and a permanent fix so toggling org retention doesn't stomp linked sub-org aggregates. Drafting P0.

alex_sre: action items: 1) support message to customer with temp ETA for backfill 2) eng to run backfill and validate charts 3) infra to add guardrail to retention job to never override linked-org retention.

sam_support: I told Acme: "We're investigating root cause. We can backfill the missing manager data in ~3–4 hours if you approve a maintenance window. Engineering owns permanent fix." They requested we proceed.

dmitri_eng: starting backfill now. command: ```
POST /internal/jobs/backfill
{
  "job": "agg-manager-backfill",
  "org_id": "acme-42",
  "start": "2025-01-01",
  "end": "2025-03-31"
}
```

metrics-bot: job agg-manager-backfill queued (job-id: job-56421)

dmitri_eng: 30m in: backfill read ~14M events, writing aggregates to `aggregates-manager-2025-01-01_2025-03-31`. running validation query now.

sam_support: customer asked for temporary dashboard workaround while backfill runs — can we surface user-level sums for managers? will that be accurate?

dmitri_eng: possible but not ideal. user-level sums will double-count if a manager appears both as a user and manager role in event stream. recommend waiting for backfill for correctness.

alex_sre: infra note: added safety check to retention cron: if retention delta > 180 days && org has linked suborgs -> pause and require manual confirmation. pushing patch to staging now.

rachel_product: thanks. rasing a product issue and tracking as P0 bug: RED-4491. we need regression tests, e2e for retention change flows, and a migration plan for affected orgs.

metrics-bot: job job-56421 succeeded (duration: 2h12m).

dmitri_eng: backfill done, validation queries show manager aggregates restored for 2025-01..2025-03. patched retention job in prod to avoid overwrite.

sam_support: update sent to Acme: backfill completed and charts restored, apologised and offered 1-month credit. Customer accepted, closing case. :white_check_mark:

katie_customer_success: thanks all — please add postmortem notes and link RED-4491. I'll follow up with customer summary.
